defects: Ring hypothesis strengthened from [Semiring R] [Nontrivial R] to [CommRing R] [IsDomain R], drastically narrowing the class of rings covered (loses noncommutative rings and general semirings with zero divisors)

Torsion condition inlined as ∃ r ≠ 0, r • m = 0 instead of using Mathlib's Module.IsTorsion (which requires r to be a non-zero-divisor, i.e. r ∈ nonZeroDivisors R); this only coincides with 'r ≠ 0' because IsDomain is additionally assumed, so it is not a faithful restatement of IsTorsion for general rings
Produced statement is a narrower special case rather than an equivalent reformulation of the gold theorem
